purpose: Documented primary-frequency dynamics (turbine governors, machine damping) for the Singh & Pal (2013) v3.3 IEEE 68-bus benchmark, which itself ignores governors and sets D = 0.

pst_data16m.description: Power System Toolbox (Chow & Rogers) 16-machine, 68-bus data file; same system and the same scheduled generation as Singh & Pal v3.3 (P = 2.50, 5.45, 6.50, 6.32, 5.052, 7.00, 5.60, 5.40, 8.00, 5.00, 10.00, 13.50, 35.91, 17.85, 10.00 pu, slack 40.00); generator buses numbered 53-68 instead of 1-16; machine electrical data differ from v3.3 (GE 1981 source).
used: mac_con column 17 (d_o, damping, pu on machine base)
tg_con block (commented out in the file, 'tg_con = [];' follows it)

pst_tg_model.equations: demand = Pref + (wref - w)/R;  Ts dtg1/dt = demand - tg1;  Tc dtg2/dt = (1 - T3/Tc) tg1 - tg2;  T5 dtg3/dt = (tg2 + (T3/Tc) tg1)(1 - T4/T5) - tg3;  Pm = tg3 + (T4/T5)(tg2 + (T3/Tc) tg1); demand limited to [0, Tmax] (not active at any small-signal equilibrium). Initialization tg1 = Pm0, tg2 = (1 - T3/Tc) Pm0, tg3 = (1 - T4/T5) Pm0, Pref = Pm0.

sources.singh_pal_v33: Singh & Pal (2013), IEEE PES TF Benchmark report v3.3: governors ignored, mechanical torque constant, D = 0 (configs/ieee68/G3_preregistration.yaml).

governor.model: PST tg model 1 (simplified steam turbine with reheat)
governor.per_machine: identical for all 16 machines in the documented block

machine_mapping_rule: PST machine i (bus 52 + i) is Singh & Pal machine i (bus i): identical scheduled active power sequence.
base_conversion: Physical quantities are preserved: a damping or droop coefficient in pu on the PST rating becomes coefficient * rating_mva / Sn_SP on the Singh & Pal device base (Sn_SP = 100 or 200 MVA, the mac_con MVA column of v3.3). Equivalently the damping torque and the governor response are the same number of MW per pu speed deviation in both files.

variants.REAL: Singh & Pal v3.3 + PST governors on every surviving synchronous machine + PST damping d_o on every surviving machine (non-zero only on the area equivalents G13-G16). Confirmatory model.
variants.NOGOV: REAL with the governors removed (damping kept). Ablation B.
variants.SP33: Singh & Pal v3.3 exactly as published and validated in Gate 3: no governors, D = 0. Ablation C.

replaced_units: A replaced machine is removed with its governor and damping; the grid-following converter carries its P and Q and has no frequency response (the frozen TX4 GFL).
